data.title: 尤贝尔 · 黑暗料理的现场
data.description: 借住处的厨房，她哼着歌往锅里投入颜色可疑的食材，锅里冒出不该出现的颜色的蒸汽；端上桌时一脸期待地盯着试吃者，黑暗料理名不虚传。
data.action: 借住处的厨房，她哼着歌往锅里投入颜色可疑的食材，锅里冒出不该出现的颜色的蒸汽
data.promptProse: Humming in the borrowed kitchen, Ubel drops a suspiciously colorful vegetable into the stew, hopeful amusement in her purple eyes as greenish steam curls upward. A plain linen apron covers her green long-sleeved shirt and black trousers. The medium view includes the spoon and chopping board along the counter, with the pot before her. Warm kitchen light brightens the unusual mixture and pot rim, casting spoon shadows on the board.
